title: Netherlands Returns Historic 11th-Century Chola Dynasty 'Leiden' Copper Plates to India
summary: Dutch PM Rob Jetten hands over 24 Anaimangalam Chola copper plates (30 kg with imperial seal) to PM Modi in The Hague after 14-year campaign.

blocks.text: 🪝 Netherlands Returns Historic 11th-Century Chola Dynasty 'Leiden' Copper Plates to India. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: During PM Modi's visit to The Hague, the Netherlands government formally returned the 11th-century **Chola dynasty 'Leiden' copper plates** (21 large & 3 small plates in Sanskrit & Tamil), taken in 1712.
